scope: Frozen archival thermal-response indicator; not verified physical capacity or fire resistance.

table_1.J_definition: Trapezoidal time integral of the61-point response divided by3600s; compute absolute scalar error per geometry, average cases within seed, then average five seeds.
table_1.CI: Existing1000-replicate crossed geometry-by-seed percentile95 interval; no new resampling and no multiple-comparison adjustment. No inference from rounded signs.

table_2.reference: E reference first-grid events and C right-censored cases by3600s; E+C=N, identical across all models/seeds.
table_2.event: First recorded response at or below q on0:60:3600s; no temporal interpolation, clipping, or prediction envelope.
table_2.errors: Separate maximum single-seed false-negative and false-positive counts over five seeds; not totals over5N and not necessarily the same checkpoint.
table_2.coverage: Minimum both_event_count over seeds, displayed as n_common/E. n_common is the intersection of reference and that model's event set within one seed. E=0 yields NA. It is not a two-model intersection or a cohort shared across seeds.
table_2.seed_extrema: MaxFN, maxFP and minimum coverage can arise in different seeds; cannot be combined into one worst checkpoint.
table_2.NA: Undefined class-denominator rates, event coverage, or conditional times remainNA. A valid zero count is not a claim of a zero rate with no eligible class.

cross_protocol_dependence: IID, countOOD and LOCO evaluation populations overlap; never sum their N as independent cases.
external_fire_precision_note: No rho is exported. Tiny floating-point differences under identical fire-only inputs do not demonstrate geometric ranking capability; retain frozen ranking results and the separate precision note elsewhere.
layout: Two compact supplementary tables; aim for one A4 page with readable small text. Do not force one page by illegible scaling. Main manuscript may cite these tables.
release_gate: All12 protocols each35 actual results plus final full420 replay and complete CI/independent review metadata; then bind source hashes before reading/deriving score payloads.
